intro: Financial services and government organisations bore the brunt of a phishing campaign surge between April and July 2026, with 62 incidents recorded. The activity, which spanned global regions including Latin America, the United States, Canada, and Russia, involved threat actors Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit. Exploited vulnerabilities included CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893. The severity mix comprised 54 high-severity and 8 medium-severity events, affecting sectors such as hospitality, cryptocurrency, and technology.
